text: {"headline":"Reviewer brief on procurement scoring and consulting records","overview":"The supplied claims concern a score-change request, committee accounts, an award approval, and consulting ledger entries. Records and attributed allegations require separate consideration.","key_points":["PERSON_1 requested increasing ORG_2's technical score from 61 to 78, asserted prior verbal committee agreement, and said recirculation was unnecessary. The assertion does not independently establish agreement. [C004, C005, C006]","A redacted chat participant stated that the committee had not yet met; minutes record a meeting on 10 March 2026. This creates uncertainty about the basis of the asserted prior verbal agreement, although verbal agreement and a formal meeting are distinct. [C005, C008, C010]","The minutes record technical scores of 78 for ORG_2 and 74 for ORG_4, recommend the estimated $1.2M contract to ORG_2, and record no declared conflicts. An approval entry records PERSON_4's approval on 14 March 2026. [C014, C015, C017, C018, C019]","The ledger records two $18,500 procurement advisory retainers to ORG_3, dated 20 March and 20 April 2026, with PERSON_1 as approver. [C020, C021]","The reporter alleges noticing two consulting payments after contract signing and being unable to find an agreement. The ledger supports the recorded amounts and recipient, but does not establish the reporter's account of signing or agreement availability. [C020, C021, C024, C025, C027]"],"risk_notes":["PERSON_5's account that PERSON_1 linked a score increase to avoiding another quarter's delay is a reported statement, not independent proof of the projected delay. [C007]","The reporter's believed connection between ORG_3 and PERSON_3, whom the reporter identifies as PERSON_1's husband, remains unverified; the reporter says they have no supporting documents. No declared conflicts does not establish that no conflict existed. [C018, C028, C029, C035]"],"limitations":["The supplied claims do not independently establish whether prior verbal committee agreement occurred, why the score changed, or whether the change was justified.","The award approval does not establish contract execution, and ledger entries do not independently establish funds transfer or services delivered.","The evidence does not establish whether a consulting agreement existed or any relationship between ORG_3 and PERSON_3. The reporter's inability to find an agreement is not proof of its absence.","Several dates remain unresolved in the calibrated claims. Claims flagged as unsupported and citing an injected passage were excluded from substantive findings."]}
